text: Attempt 9 begins: attempt 8's plan (ahead of attempt 6 for 20 years) + disaster.sh for every disaster + taxes held near 8% from 30,000 people.

Attempt 9 started. Attempt 8 was the best start yet (ahead of the record city for 20 years) until a fire I let run unwatched in 2038. Same plan, and now every disaster is handled in short watched bursts.
Feb 2001: loan #2, 2003 district.
Jul 2002: loans #3-4: coal plant + 19 north pumps, second coal plant + north job district.
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1994), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 6 (demand -1904), shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1896), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Zoo from cash; finance ordinances + City Beautification.
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1144)
Jul 2004: loan #5: seaport job strip, east-edge homes with their power feeds; airport from cash.
Dec 2004: loans #6-7: south pumps, district 5; stadium + 4 fire stations from cash.
Feb 2006: loan #8: east coal plant + fire station, factory + home block by the seaport.
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1032)
Feb 2008: loan #9: south mixed district (factory demand 1,290).
Jul 2008: south-east district + road links east and south from cash.
Loan 10: south coal plant and second seaport (joined to road row 55; its old extra road was not needed)
Feb 2010, 30,070 people. Took loan 10 for a power plant (power was down to 7% spare) and a second seaport for factory jobs.
Tax controller: homes 6 -> 7 (demand 1139)
Loan 11: 7 lake-shore pumps (water 5% spare), south band (shops+factories+homes) and south-west band (homes+shops)
Jul 2011, 34,080 people. Shops and homes ran out of land and water fell to 5%. Loan 11 paid for lake pumps and two new districts in the south.
Rezoned two empty factory rows of the south band (y119, y124) to shops: shop demand 1,793 with no land, factory demand negative
Loan 12: river crossing - bridge + west district, west coal plant, west-edge road link ($1,000 charged)
Feb 2013, 39,920 people - right on pace. Homes ran out of land, so loan 12 paid for the jump across the river: a bridge, a west district, a power plant and a road link at the west edge.
Tax controller: factories 10 -> 9 (demand -432)
Tax controller: shops 10 -> 9 (demand -629)
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 8 (demand -858)
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 8 (demand 172)
Loans 13-14: zoo #3 and the second west district with riverbank pumps; tax 8/8/9
Jul 2015, 44,380 people, cash slightly negative and a bit behind attempt 8. Took loans 13-14 for a zoo (home cap) and the second west district with water pumps. Home tax up to 8%.
NW coal plant + fire station; west strip x10-19 y28-61 (factories, shops, homes)
CONTROL: the west4 build left a stray 3-tile bridge at x13 y63-65 (audit FAIL: road not joined); joined it to road x13 with one road tile
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 7 (demand -394), factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1069)
Loan 15: west shop cells x21-39 y21-26, marina on the SW river shore, zoo at 49,99 (home demand only +70)
Jul 2017, 52,760 people - ahead of pace and of attempt 8. Loan 15 paid for a shop district; a marina and another zoo should lift the cap on homes.
10 shore pumps (x70 y103-107, SW lake y76 x31-35): spare water 8%
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1384)
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1596)
Loans 16-17: south-west strip district x8-27 y71-97 (factories/shops/homes bands) and a coal plant on the west riverbank strip
Dec 2018, 58,130 people - about 4,000 ahead of attempt 8. Loans 16-17 paid for the big south-west strip district and another power plant.
Tax controller: factories 10 -> 9 (demand -919)
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 8 (demand -699), factories 9 -> 8 (demand -882)
Aug 2020: the SW coal plant burned (fire spread into the SW strip district, 79 rubble tiles, district unpowered). Game paused; bulldozing a 105-tile firebreak around the flames before running again
Aug 2020, 60,900 people. A fire destroyed the south-west power plant and is spreading in that district. Game paused; clearing a firebreak around it.
Sep 2020: fire over. SW district lost its buildings, roads and lines (zones kept), the SW coal plant and zoo #4 at 49,99 burned. Loan 18 to rebuild plant + fire station, roads/lines, zoo
Sep 2020: the fire is out, but it burned most of the south-west district, its power plant and a zoo. Taking loan 18 to rebuild them.

CONTROL: the SW rebuild (c4a8-sw) landed shifted ~(+14,+8) - a copy of the district was built on empty land x22-41 y78-105 (keeping it); a stray Raise Terrain click raised (25,80). Fix: autocal now fails when the zoom check's second road does not land (it used to skip the check)
SW district repaired: rubble cleared, coal plant + fire station, roads, zoo rebuilt; power joined around road junctions; shifted copy x22-41 y78-104 linked (power, water, roads). Audit passed.
Sep 2020: the burned south-west district is rebuilt and powered again, plus an extra block that was built by mistake but is now usable. 60,900 people, 18 loans, cash low.
Tax controller: homes 8 -> 7 (demand -161), shops 8 -> 6 (demand -1088), factories 8 -> 7 (demand -201)
Feb 2021: all demand negative (shops -1,088), unemployment 8% -> taxes 7/6/7
Loan 19: river pumps x59-60 y88-101 and 4 west-bank shore pumps x59 y39-42 (+ feed line from the riverbank coal plant): spare water 9%
Loans 20-21: stadium #2 at 43,84; new strip districts south (x12-52 y106-121) and by the east river (x43-58 y88-98)
Nov 2023, 70,700 people - recovered from the fire and nearly back on pace. Homes and factories are out of land: loans 20-21 pay for a second stadium and two new districts in the south.
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 8 (demand 1543), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 1123)
Nov 2024: coal plant at 53,101 (+fire station) for spare power 9%; homes zoned on the empty rows y93-94 of the east-river strip (TRIPS weak, home demand 1,716)
Nov 2024, 75,070 people - ahead of pace again. Added a power plant and homes beside the new factories.
Tax controller: homes 8 -> 9 (demand 1796)
Jul 2025, 81,280 people - ahead of pace and of every earlier attempt at this date. Homes and shops need land: loan 22 pays for a new strip district on the empty north of the west bank.
Tax controller: homes 9 -> 10 (demand 1971), shops 6 -> 7 (demand 2000)
Feb 2026: 6 fire stations (SW district, west coal plant, east gaps) - fire cover 13 stations for 84,710
autocal: an unverified zoom now tries the next spot and only fails if no spot verifies (the first rule gave a false alarm in a built-up view)
Jul 2026, 86,610 people - about 6,000 ahead of pace. Loan 23 pays for a homes-and-shops district on the last big free land on the east bank.
autocal: at the east map edge the zoom-check road (32 px right/down) fell off the map -> now also tries 32 px left/up
Loan 23: east strip x109-125 y63-96 (homes/shops), powered from the east-edge coal plant's fire station
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Jul 2027, 89,990 people - 6,000 ahead of pace. Power is at 9% and shops need land: loan 24 pays for a power plant and a shop strip on the empty north edge of the west bank.
Jul 2027: NW coal plant #2 (10,21) + fire station; north shop strip x21-40 y1-11; 7 west-riverbank shore pumps x58-59 y28-34; power link (37,28) for shops x35-39
Aug 2027: the 2006 coal plant at 78,35 wore out (no fire) - rubble cleared and a new coal plant built on the same lot
Aug 2027, 91,360 people. The first coal plant wore out after 21 years; replaced it on the same spot.
Loan 25: 22 more pumps on the south lake shore (spare water 3%, 143 dry)

Sep 2028: alien-ship disaster set 5 fires (one in the dense middle x99-106 y61-70). Game paused; 161-tile firebreak rings (flames read by yellow pixels, not red roofs). autocal gained a power-line fallback for fully built views (no empty land for a test road)
Sep 2028, 94,400 people: an alien ship is walking through the city and started five fires. Game paused while I cut firebreaks around each.

CONTROL: disaster.sh watched only the view around the alien ship; a fire elsewhere grew over 17 bursts into a great fire across the east bank (~1,700 burning tiles). Fix: disaster.sh also counts rubble on the whole map after each burst and stops at +25. Cutting a 794-tile firebreak along the whole front (flames scanned from 14 views)
Sep 2028: the alien ship's fires became a great fire that has burned most of the east bank. Cutting a second firebreak around the new front; the west bank and the south are still intact.

CONTROL: the second firebreak never ran - autocal found no spot for its zoom check in burned/built views. Fix: accept the zoom when the first test road lands where step 8 predicts from the view centre (spot 80+ px out)

Oct 2028: the alien-ship great fire is over. Population 94,400 -> 48,320; 3,470 rubble tiles (942 road and 663 line tiles, a coal plant, stadium, 2 zoos, 3 fire stations burned). Firefighter dispatch (Emergency tool) finally slowed it.
Loans 26-27 (over the loan floor, LOAN_OK): rebuild every burned road, line and pump from the Jul 2028 save (1,567 tiles, ~$16k)
Oct 2028: the great fire is out. The city fell from 94,400 to 48,320 people, but the zones survived. Taking two loans to rebuild every burned road, power line and pump so the east bank can regrow.
Rebuild: bulldozing 1,567 rubble tiles one by one took ~12 s a tile; a test showed roads go straight onto rubble, so the rest of the plan runs without the bulldoze step

CONTROL: autocal's zoom-fail exits left test roads behind (strays all over the rebuild area; near the north edge the view cannot centre and the zoom checks misfire). Fix: autocal sweeps every new road tile on every exit; strays bulldozed

New tool powerfix.py: shortest power lines from the powered grid to every dark zone area, passing through cut-off lines/buildings for free and crossing roads only straight. After the fire: 19 dark areas fixed with 63 line tiles

CONTROL: my Oct 2028 autocal change (sweep test roads on zoom-fail exits) bulldozed with a wrong calibration and destroyed 2 fire stations, a power-line link and 5 road tiles. Reverted (strays are left to build.py's verified final sweep); damage being repaired

Rebuild done: roads/lines/pumps from the Jul 2028 save, powerfix links, west-bank road joined again at x76. build.py now only bulldozes outside the plan after a road- or line-verified calibration. Small FAILs left (5 pumps, short road pieces)
